content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00029, SRS_Rte_00082 The RTE shall ignore the received responseSignal if multiple clients are connected to this responseSignal, the Client Server Communication Graph is not handled by an RTE Implementation Plug-In and no valid transaction handle could be retrieved (e.g. due to a transformer hard error or the RTE not being able to allocate the buffer to transform the data).
